name: Alto
source: The first prince of the country of Kanemotia, a graceful and attractive young man skilled in both literary and military matters. As he's such a kind and noble man, many women in his country long to be with him.
translation: The first prince of the country of Kanemotia, a graceful and attractive young man skilled in both literary and military matters. As he's such a kind and noble man, many women in his country long to be with him.
